'''2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam Mike Fitzgerald The Fragile''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Mike Fitzgerald]] posted on DeckTech after playing it at [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam]]. The post (21 March 2000) says: "This is the LS Deck I used at theFlorida Grand Slam." No record or placing is given. (The 2000 Florida Grand Slam was held at Merritt Island, March 2000.)<ref name="dt-4549">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4549 The Fragile], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 21 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4549/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4549/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018192436/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4549/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''The Fragile'''
* '''Author:''' Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald
* '''Published:''' March 21, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is the LS Deck I used at theFlorida Grand Slam. Its one of thebetter LS out there now.

=== Strategy ===

I'm not sure how to explain this one. Should be pretty obvious from the cards. Get a bunch of generation and Tunnel Vision to setup the combos. The multiple Destinies can be used to apply beatdown but I really wasn't able to beatdown on anyone...people don't spread out much anymore.

Against everything you should start Wise Advice unless your sure of NO Sac or small amount of interrupts.

v. HDADTJ  Dueling Protection and Spies. Pretty much solid here.

v. Ralltiir Ops  I had a tough time busting up Ralltiir Ops but after 12 Luke/Obi strikes I was able to do it ;) I'll probably start adding Melas and Bron Burs or something so I can combat this decktype better.

v. Court  You can bring the Mains in with authority Skywalkers cancels Imperial Barrier so you only have to worry about None Shall Pass which you can Grapple.

==== Anything Else ====

Manip protection , #s protection , Barrier stoppers...etc.
